description: Gigasim benchmark: pipeline throughput and backpressure, transaction execution phases, FlatKV commit and read paths, WAL, Pebble internals, and host resources.

panels.title: Blocks Processed / sec
panels.description: Blocks that completed every stage: generation, execution, state commit and receipt write.

panels.title: Transactions Executed / sec
panels.description: The headline number for a gigasim run.

panels.title: Account Population
panels.description: Hot accounts are the working set transactions draw from; cold accounts are eligible but rarely picked.

panels.title: Staged Block Queue Depth
panels.description: Generated blocks waiting to enter the pipeline. A persistently full queue means storage is the limit; a persistently empty one means generation is.

panels.title: Main-Thread Time Distribution
panels.description: Where the block-processing thread spends its time.

panels.title: Generator Time Distribution
panels.description: Where the generator thread spends its time. A large 'throttling' slice means BlocksPerSecond is the binding limit, not the stack.

panels.title: Block Hash Wait
panels.description: Time the main thread blocked waiting for a block hash to be computed.

panels.title: Executor Time Distribution
panels.description: Summed across every executor thread. The six read phases hit the state DB; update_balances is the only write phase. Executor phases are recorded for a TransactionMetricsSampleRate share of transactions (1% by default), so absolute durations understate real time. Relative shares and latency percentiles are unaffected.

panels.title: Executor Time Share by Phase
panels.description: Each phase's share of total executor time. Normalised rather than absolute, so it stays readable regardless of TransactionMetricsSampleRate.

panels.title: Executor Phase Latency (p99)
panels.description: Executor phases are recorded for a TransactionMetricsSampleRate share of transactions (1% by default), so absolute durations understate real time. Relative shares and latency percentiles are unaffected.

panels.title: State DB: Commits & Changes / sec
panels.description: One commit per block; changes are the deduplicated key-value writes that block carried.

panels.title: Version & Snapshot Height
panels.description: A widening gap means snapshot writing is falling behind commits.

panels.title: View Cache Hit Ratio
panels.description: Every transaction issues six reads, so a dip here shows up directly in executor phase latency.

panels.title: WAL Queue Depth
panels.description: Sampled on an interval rather than per record, so short spikes can be missed.

panels.title: WAL Files Sealed / Pruned per sec
Estimated Compaction Debt
panels.description: Bytes compaction still owes. Sustained growth means writes are outrunning compaction.

panels.title: GC Time Spent (fraction)
panels.description: Seconds of garbage collection per second of wall clock.

title: GigaSim
